exam.syllabus_cycle: Not printed on the PDF (file dated December 2020; scheme headed 'from June 2017 and onward'); linked from the CSIR-HRDG syllabus page on 2026-11-16
exam.verification_note: Verified 2026-11-16 against earth_science_syllabus.pdf, the only syllabus PDF on the CSIR-HRDG Earth Sciences page (csirhrdg.res.in/Home/Index/1/InPage/36/26); the file is the same one linked there today, dated December 2020 with no newer version offered: the five Part B areas and the four Part C Ocean Sciences headings (Physical, Chemical, Geological and Biological Oceanography) match the PDF's numbered headings in order. The PDF is one paper with five Part C branches, so each branch is its own plan. Part A topics are the three areas named in the exam scheme on that page. The PDF's Geological Oceanography entry only says 'Same topics as under subhead Marine Geology & paleo-oceanography'; the plan keeps it as one topic. Headings were compared; the sub-points under each were not.
